name: Alert Condition
description: One predicate of a compound Alert Type. Conditions sharing a Group are combined with AND; groups are combined with OR (fires when any group fully matches).

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Same group = AND. Different groups = OR.

fields.label: Condition
fields.options:
is greater than (>)
is greater than or equal to (≥)
is less than (<)
is less than or equal to (≤)
is exactly (=)
is not (≠)

fields.label: Value
fields.description: Number for numeric readings; the state (e.g. OFFLINE / Yes) for category or Yes-No readings.
